name: slack
title: Slack
description: A Slack workspace, reached as your own bot (its bot token) or as you (Slack sign-in).
needed_for: Reads one Slack channel into conversations and replies there.
justification: A Slack source reads a channel's history and posts replies. With a bot token it acts as that bot and only where the bot was invited; with a sign-in it acts as the person who signed in.

SLACK_BOT_TOKEN.label: Bot token
SLACK_BOT_TOKEN.hint: Your Slack app's Bot User OAuth Token (OAuth & Permissions). Replies come from the bot.

SLACK_SIGNIN.label: Sign in with Slack
SLACK_SIGNIN.hint: Acts as you: replies are posted under your name.

bot.label: Your own bot
bot.hint: Paste the bot token of a Slack app you created.
